notes.title: Tennis Elbow Manager 2 version 1.0 !
notes.notes:
After a few months in Beta, the game has finally reached the state where it deserves the v1.0 label ! ːsteamhappyː

There's no common big bad bug anymore (although it may still have a few rare ones, so be sure to report them if you meet them), and all base features are there now with the Steam achievements and the completed documentation.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33469150/7e82095f52bea603b5d005d5cb697693b5e49658.jpg

In the incoming months I will still add small user-requested features, and in the years to come I'll try to regularly add bigger features or do some noticeable rehauls from your feedback.

For now, I'll let the game in the Early Access state as it might still need a series of polishing, and to encourage new users to give feedback & feature requests..! :-)

notes.title: Version 1.0j released !
notes.notes:
Hello,

version 1.0j has just been released.

This version allows the engine to render faster than 60 images per second, up to 144 fps ; this means if your monitor supports a refresh rate higher than 60hz, the game will look a lot more smooth.

Also, depending of your setup, the game may also look smoother at 60hz, especially as the time polling got a couple of fixes.

Changelog since release of the game on Steam can be read here : http://steamcommunity.com/app/346470/discussions/0/618456760265331075/ .

Enjoy ! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Version 1.0g released !
notes.notes:
Hello,

Version 1.0g has been released.

New Features :

World Tour : rankings & career's end wall of fame stats updated to beginning of 2016
GUI : strike speed shown for each player, under their stamina bars
Online : message shown when your opponent is doing a screenshot

notes.title: Mac Version Ok, Linux Version Almost Ok !
notes.notes:
Hello,

I have updated the Mac OSX version last month and now it seems to be finally alright, especially as I fixed a nasty rendering bug which had appeared on the new OSX El Capitan !

I also updated the Linux version this week and it seems to run fine on Ubuntu 12.04, but for Ubuntu 14.04 there's still some doubts if it works in all situations or not.

Don't hesitate to report your experience in the forum of the game => http://steamcommunity.com/app/346470/discussions/ .
